```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(tidyr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
trend <- risk |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d),
    entry_ev = sum(outcome_nfl_entry_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    drafted = drafted_ev / seasons,
    entry = entry_ev / seasons,
    drafted_lo = vapply(seq_along(seasons), \(i) wilson(drafted_ev[i], seasons[i])[["lo"]], numeric(1)),
    drafted_hi = vapply(seq_along(seasons), \(i) wilson(drafted_ev[i], seasons[i])[["hi"]], numeric(1)),
    entry_lo = vapply(seq_along(seasons), \(i) wilson(entry_ev[i], seasons[i])[["lo"]], numeric(1)),
    entry_hi = vapply(seq_along(seasons), \(i) wilson(entry_ev[i], seasons[i])[["hi"]], numeric(1))
  )
y0 <- min(trend$draft_year)
y1 <- max(trend$draft_year)
tr <- function(y, col) trend[[col]][trend$draft_year == y]
trend_tip <- function(label, col) {
  sprintf("%d, %s: %.1f%% of %s eligible seasons", trend$draft_year, label, 100 * trend[[col]], fmt(trend$seasons))
}

p <- ggplot(trend, aes(draft_year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = entry_lo, ymax = entry_hi), fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = drafted_lo, ymax = drafted_hi), fill = "#1B9E77", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = entry), linewidth = 1.4, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_line(aes(y = drafted), linewidth = 1.6, colour = "#1B9E77") +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(y = entry, tooltip = trend_tip("NFL entry", "entry")), size = 2.6, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(y = drafted, tooltip = trend_tip("drafted", "drafted")), size = 2.6, colour = "#1B9E77") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = y1,
    y = tr(y1, "drafted") - 0.008,
    label = sprintf("Drafted: %.1f%% in %d, %.1f%% in %d", 100 * tr(y0, "drafted"), y0, 100 * tr(y1, "drafted"), y1),
    size = 5.5,
    hjust = 1,
    colour = "#1B9E77"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = y0,
    y = tr(y0, "entry") + 0.012,
    label = "NFL entry",
    size = 5.5,
    hjust = 0,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2016.3,
    y = tr(2016, "entry") + 0.01,
    label = "Undrafted signings recorded\nfrom the 2016 class on",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(y0, y1, by = 3)) +
  labs(
    title = "Drafted and NFL entry shares by draft class",
    subtitle = "Bands are confidence intervals",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Share of eligible seasons",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "drafted-share-by-class", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: counts
trend_counts <- trend |>
  transmute(
    draft_year,
    `Eligible seasons` = seasons,
    Drafted = drafted_ev,
    `Undrafted free agent` = entry_ev - drafted_ev
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-draft_year, names_to = "measure", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, c("Eligible seasons", "Drafted", "Undrafted free agent")))
p_counts <- ggplot(trend_counts, aes(draft_year, n)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = measure,
      tooltip = sprintf("%d class, %s: %s", draft_year, tolower(measure), fmt(n)),
      data_id = paste(draft_year, measure)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Eligible seasons" = "grey55", Drafted = "#1B9E77", `Undrafted free agent` = "#7570B3"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(y0, y1, 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Eligible seasons and NFL entrants by draft class",
    subtitle = "Each panel on its own scale",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Count",
    caption = "Hover a bar for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_counts)
```
